stories.title: fal offers a limited Seedance 2.5 trial
stories.summary: Recent fal accounts can claim five free 10-second, 480p videos until November 22 at 11:59 PM PST. The offer covers designated playground and agent interfaces. API requests remain paid.
stories.insight: Use one campaign brief across text, image and reference inputs, then compare character consistency and usable shots.

stories.title: Gemini adds GIF creation
stories.summary: Google announced GIF creation in Gemini using Omni 1.2 Flash. The help page describes a gradual rollout for Google AI plan users in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, Korea, the U.K. and the U.S.
stories.insight: A small set of branded reaction GIFs can test loop quality, text rendering and character consistency.

stories.title: OpenAI announces broader access to business agents
stories.summary: In a November 20 post, OpenAI said ecommerce and online service businesses outside the U.S. can now claim their business and publish agents in ChatGPT. Eligibility and verification still apply.
stories.insight: Check Business Hub eligibility before preparing product and policy data. Claiming a business does not guarantee placement or sales.

stories.title: A developer compares Gemini reasoning effort and cost
stories.summary: Simon Willison published an SVG test across Gemini 4 models and effort levels. In his Hydrogen example, high cost 3.99 cents and xhigh cost 23.61 cents. This is a single task, not a general benchmark.
stories.insight: Compare effort level, latency and output quality on representative work before choosing a model configuration.

stories.title: Runway demonstrates conversational video creation
stories.summary: Runway shared a demonstration of making videos through a short conversation with Runway Agent. The post focuses on the workflow and does not specify new pricing or universal availability.
stories.insight: Try a real brand story and follow how the agent handles the brief, shot planning and revisions.

stories.title: Runway explains how it reviews agent-written changes
stories.summary: Runway says agents have written nearly every merged App Studio pull request since October. Its engineering write-up describes review, browser testing and escalation of high-risk decisions to engineers.
stories.insight: Automated work needs explicit acceptance criteria, visible test evidence and a clear point for human decisions.

stories.title: Google shares a Gemini-built ski simulator
stories.summary: Google DeepMind demonstrated a Mont Blanc ski simulator coded with Gemini 4 Neon in Antigravity. The team says it uses custom shaders and no pre-made 3D models, and links to an interactive version.
stories.insight: Interactive campaign prototypes should be judged on controls and runtime stability as well as the first visual impression.

stories.title: OpenAI introduces MedChemBench
stories.summary: The benchmark contains 99 problems drawn from published medicinal chemistry research. It separates molecular reconstruction, explanation, compound selection and property prediction. OpenAI says the results do not establish real-world drug discovery ability.
stories.insight: Break specialist evaluation into distinct capabilities so an aggregate score does not hide weaknesses in consequential choices.

stories.title: Vercel completes AI management system certification
stories.summary: Vercel announced ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification for its AI management system, including core products such as AI Gateway, Vercel Agent and v0, alongside relevant people and processes.
stories.insight: Enterprise buyers may ask for evidence of impact assessment, governance ownership and continuing review alongside product capabilities.

stories.title: Adobe shares a fictional iced-tea brand concept
stories.summary: Adobe Firefly highlighted Bleek Studio’s floral visual concept for a mock iced-tea brand called San Capri. The post presents creative work and does not report campaign or conversion results.
stories.insight: A concept can inform packaging and visual direction while commercial impact still needs separate evidence.
